_comment: Cube config for the separate GT-validation cube (see cube_solid.json).
Same six AprilTag 36h11 markers and sizes as the main cube; only the body
shape and the two top-marker centers differ.
Object frame: origin at the center of the 59 x 59 x 59 mm body, +Z up.
overall 59 x 88 x 94 mm = body 59 + top protrusion 35 (riser 25 + I-plate 10)
side markers 2..5 : body face centers, z = 0
top markers 0,1   : centered on the two 31 x 31 I-plate blocks,
y = -/+28.5, on the top surface z = +64.5
physical cube -- re-run the face-roll self-calibration before trusting it.
multi-marker corner RMSE 2.29 -> 0.49 px. Gauge markers: [5].

Global marker scale 0.99 applied (marker sizes and all marker positions) on 2026-09-15 after cam 039422061216 intrinsics were re-shot: scale sweep 0.985..1.01 of the 0914 unified fit gives train RMSE 0.549 (1.0) -> 0.529 (0.99) px and session2 posterior cube agreement 6.3 -> 1.6 mm. Printed markers ~1% smaller than nominal (51 -> 50.49 mm, 25 -> 24.75 mm). Please confirm with calipers.

2026-09-17: marker scale reverted 0.99 -> 1.0. Basis: operator (sstone) confirms the printed markers are dimensionally correct at nominal size (51 mm / 25 mm); the 0.99 factor had been selected by a data sweep, not by physical measurement. Reverted values: marker sizes, marker_center_m, and the translation column of marker_pose_4x4 were all divided by 0.99 (rotations and cube_side_m untouched). EXPECTED SIDE EFFECTS from the 0915 sweep record: train RMSE 0.529 -> 0.549 px, session2 posterior cube agreement 1.6 -> 6.3 mm, and the z common-mode bias (+2.0~2.2 mm) should drop toward 0. If the 8 mm camera-pair disagreement reappears, that error is real and was previously being absorbed by the scale factor - investigate intrinsics, not the marker size.

2026-09-17: I-plate neck measured with calipers at 26mm (not the 25mm drawing value used previously) -- see cube_solid.json. This shifts the top-marker gauge (0,1) I-plate block center from y=+/-28 to y=+/-28.5mm. marker_center_m for ids 0/1 updated accordingly; calibrate_gt_cube_geometry.py then re-run with --write to re-fit the side markers (2..5) against the corrected gauge.
multi-marker corner RMSE 0.45 -> 0.32 px. Gauge markers: [0, 1].
